lines.text: The son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father curses the Name in the camp, and they bring him to Moses.
His mother is Shelomith of the tribe of Asher, and they place him in custody until the LORD's will is clear.
The LORD tells Moses to take the blasphemer outside the camp, and all who heard him lay hands on his head.
Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death, and injuries are repaid with the same injury.
The LORD gives one standard of law for foreign resident and native, and the Israelites burn the blasphemer outside the camp.
